💳 Payables Dashboard Vendors & Contractors

Order → bill → payment position per vendor, with advances, retention, holds and a dated due horizon. Approved documents only; pending approvals shown separately.
Order AllWOHOPO Show With duesAll vendorsOverdue only As on

Payment horizon

net payable by due date · approved bills only · click any bucket or KPI card to list the records
OverdueDue in 7 days8 – 30 days31 – 60 days60+ daysNot yet payable
VendorOrdersOrder value Billed invoice · GST · TDS Net payablePaid Due overdue O/S advance paid · recovered Held retention · hold
Loading…
How figures are derived. Order value = live WO/HO total + PO grand total. Invoice value, GST, TDS, retention, hold and net payable come from approved bills (WOB / HOB / POB); Paid = allocations on approved payment transfers. Due = net payable − paid, bucketed by inv_pay_due (or bill date + credit period) against the As-on date. Advance paid = approved on-account payments; recovered = advance / mobilization / on-account recovery booked on bills; retention/hold shown net of approved release allocations. Bills on payment hold are shown separately and are not payable. Pending-approval bills are excluded from Due and shown in "Not yet payable". Vendors are matched by name across documents.

Statement = chronological ledger in the vendor's favour: approved bills raise the balance by invoice value; TDS, retention, holds and advance recovery reduce it on the bill date; approved PRR vouchers reduce it on the payment date. Advances (ARR), retention releases (RRR) and hold releases (HRR) are tracked in their own tabs, not in this balance.

Material — Estimation vs PO vs GRN vs MIS

· generated
healthy
watch — variance beyond tolerance
breach — consumed > received, or received > ordered
Est  PO  GRN  MIS
Reconciled at (work package × material package × material_code × location leaf) — every stage's wbs_node_id is read as the material package it was booked to, and climbed to its work-package ancestor for the rollup. Rows stamped before tagging began (May–Jun 2026) group under Unattributed; totals still tie out. Estimation qty = Σ wbs_material_buildup.qty_total; PO = Σ pu_po_items.qty; GRN = Σ this_grn_qty; MIS = Σ qty_issued. Aggregated server-side by rpt_material_reconcile; the report projects your selected stages, measure, dates and scope.

🔒 Payment Holds

A hold stops money immediately. Lifting one needs approval.
Show On hold Release requested Payable bills Hold history
VendorBill · orderDueOutstandingHold reason / requestAction
Loading…
How holds work. A QS places a hold and it takes effect at once — the bill disappears from Record Payment and cannot be paid. Lifting a hold is a two-step: the QS requests it with a reason, and an approver decides. Every action is written to an audit log that survives the hold being lifted.

On-account payment

Money paid with no bill behind it. Recovered against future bills of the same order.

Retention / hold release

Returns money previously deducted on a bill. Approved as part of the transfer.

Roles are fixed system definitions — assign people to roles below. No one may hold both sides of a document family (maker-checker); screens are derived from the roles a person holds.

Add a user

The user receives an email to set their password and joins this project with no role. Once they confirm, they appear in Team members — assign their roles in System roles below. Until then they can sign in but see no screens.

Opening Stock Upload
Bulk upload opening stock as on 1st April. Admin only. Downloads a pre-defined Excel template — fill and upload.
Step 1 — Download Template

Download the pre-defined Excel template. Fill in your opening stock data — do not change column headers or sheet name. Rates must be basic rate (excluding GST), per UOM.

Required columns (in order):  Material Description  |  UOM  |  Opening Date  |  Quantity  |  Basic Rate (₹)  |  Category  |  Remarks
Step 2 — Upload Filled Template

Upload the filled template. The system will validate each row and show a preview before saving. Rows with missing Material Description, UOM, Quantity or Rate will be flagged.
